BiblicalUsage: Hamath the great stands in Amos as a measuring stick for Israel's pride. The prophet tells the people at ease in Zion to go and look at Hamath, and at Calneh and Gath, and ask whether those kingdoms are any better than theirs.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God names real cities when He argues with His people, because a real place is harder to argue away than an idea.
